comments.content: The `file_type_info.extension_description_overrides.push_back(...)` call is now inside the `else` block, meaning it only runs when there's no `*` wildcard. This changes the original behavior where the description override was added for every filter regardless of wildcard presence. Is this intentional? If a filter has a `*` wildcard, its description override will no longer be added, which could affect UI labeling.
